{{Draft}}
Every field of the [[Events]] forms, in the order of the form. Field names are given as they appear in the forms; where a field appears under another name in some forms, that name is given in brackets. Fields filled in automatically (who created or changed an entry, and when) are not listed.

'''Input:''' ''text'', ''number'', ''tick box'', ''list'' (choose from a fixed list) or a link to another record. '''Required''' fields must be filled in before saving. Long lists are shown on the [[Field reference/Base tables|Base tables]] page.

== Main form ==
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%"
! style="width:18%" | Field !! Meaning !! style="width:14%" | Input !! style="width:28%" | Values
|-
| '''Artist'''<br /><small>(not in the forms)</small> || The artist the event was created for. Set automatically from the artist's catalogue. || link to an artist || 
|-
| '''DirectoryID'''<br /><small>(not in the forms)</small> || An institution connected with the event. Not shown in the forms; record participants in Events Agents. || number || 
|-
| '''Event type'''<br /><small>(Event Type ID)</small> || The kind of event: solo or group exhibition, fair, award, lecture, birth, move and so on. Decides which sections make sense. || list || 63 entries, see [[Field reference/Base tables#Event types|Event types]]
|-
| '''Public''' || Tick to publish the event. || tick box || 
|-
| '''Event name'''<br /><small>(Event Name)</small> || Name of the event. Used in every language for which the Event description has no name of its own. || text || 
|-
| '''Alias''' || Short name shown in every list where the event can be picked. Use a consistent pattern, such as place and year. || text<br />'''required''' || 
|-
| '''Reference''' || A citation key or reference code. || text || 
|}

== Event description ==
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%"
! style="width:18%" | Field !! Meaning !! style="width:14%" | Input !! style="width:28%" | Values
|-
| '''Language''' || Language of the name and description; one entry per language. || list<br />'''required''' || German, English, French, Italian, Spanish
|-
| '''Event Name'''<br /><small>(Event name)</small> || Name of the event in this language. Replaces the main Event name in this language. || text<br />'''required''' || 
|-
| '''Description'''<br /><small>(Event description)</small> || Description of the event in this language. || long text || 
|}

== Locations ==
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%"
! style="width:18%" | Field !! Meaning !! style="width:14%" | Input !! style="width:28%" | Values
|-
| '''Location''' || The venue, for example a museum or gallery. || text || 
|-
| '''City''' || City of the venue. || text || 
|-
| '''Country''' || Country of the venue. || list || 265 entries, see [[Field reference/Base tables#Countries|Countries]]
|-
| '''From (day)''' || Day the event at this venue began, if known. || number || 
|-
| '''From (month)''' || Month the event at this venue began, if known. || list || January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December
|-
| '''From (year)''' || Year the event at this venue began. || number || 
|-
| '''Qualifier for start date''' || How certain the start date is, for example approximate, before or after. || list || approximate, exact, estimate, minimum, unknown, earliest, after, before, at latest, unverified, unlimited, in part
|-
| '''Until date (day)''' || Day the event at this venue ended, if known. || number || 
|-
| '''Until date (month)''' || Month the event at this venue ended, if known. || list || January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December
|-
| '''Until date (year)''' || Year the event at this venue ended. || number || 
|-
| '''Qualifier for end date''' || How certain the end date is, for example approximate, before or at latest. || list || approximate, exact, estimate, minimum, unknown, earliest, after, before, at latest, unverified, unlimited, in part
|-
| '''Duration''' || For events measured in time rather than dates: how long the event lasted. || number || 
|-
| '''Time unit''' || Unit of the duration, such as min. or h. || list || unit, kg, gr, cm, inch, m, feet, cm², m², square inch, square feet, sec., min., h., m:s, h:m:s, liter, cm³, mm³, m³, mm
|}

== Events Agents ==

! style="width:18%" | Field !! Meaning !! style="width:14%" | Input !! style="width:28%" | Values

| '''DirectoryID'''<br /><small>(Contact)</small> || A person or institution involved, as a directory entry. || link to a directory entry || 
|-
